content: 17:1-4 Qomon boru oau apand bumai igo

Yisas ende qamb ne wonou wuri imbigau yurau eng wurinob qamar: “Mi boru-boru irou munon wuri warigesia qomon boru abar qamb dieriba. Eng munon ger mi boru aba munon qei qomon boru eng gab wuritarama taut obounor eng borumesis.

Munon ger igo munon qei Qenut oabigour eng wuriba qomon boru wurisirbiga obounor eng munon eng sig mom qugurageteriba. Munon qei nomon aib ger ba tesi wogub munon eng ibiari wogub ten bisub uyer yat ariramari ten isub ya nub umorei ende qi eng wo munon qei qomon boru me wurisirbigau qi. End ne an bo imusi munon qei qomon boru wurisirbigunon qamb qoyamet igoarar.
Qomon ger ete ne igoriner: “Nonou bain qiyo ima ger qomon boru ger aba gab eng irun wab qem. Qamara misir iga gab eng ne wo musi.
Ende ebeinen eng wo worom gari end qen 7-ende qomon boru nesi ne bo oau mein burab bo qen 7-ende yar nemeinsia gab eng ne wo qomon boru nesieriner end bo tauimb misir me igu.”
17:5,6 Oau apand burau werei eng
Ende qamara wuri der Munon Barai nob qamamir: “Se quran eng in toaun eng misue eng gab ininou oau apand eng nonogursi.”

Ende qamarari Munon Barai wurinob qamar: “An oau apand baiste mastet qur qamaaman gas ende igo gab eng nam ger nob qamarar, “Ne nonou ar durun ten nerer isub bo tomon yat end nag” ende qomorunon eng an qob toat ende ebeiba.”
17:7-10 Wau unebi wonou qomon
Ende qamb qamar: “An yurau end ger wonou sarau munon ger nob qamara is man isiau wotet a wai sipsip qoat ende at qib igama an mai mi yemetet wogub is arari yar mi niba?
Ende ue, wo an igo wo wot arari yar mi yab, ya unab andara an gigit niari wo qanamt niba.
Sarau munon eng ende aba wonou munon barai eng der uber wot qemeriba? Ende wot me qemerinerei.
Eng gas ende an gor Qenu mi abar qamb aninob qamara ebet ugab gab eng an der ete qamarar, “Eng in ar sarau munon end ar sarau botoun,” ende qamarar.” Ende qamarei.
17:11-19 Yisas munon 10-ende iam tumau nob igour eng wurimusiarei
Yisas Yerusalem tap eng toat isub ne ai Samaria Galili nob wobon end qib igoai.
Isi yarab ginam ger end isa ne munon iam qarab nob igour eng 10-ende wot yarab mugenderi ete naget igo amir: “Yisas, Barai in mai intoubarinen qiyo?”
Arari Yisas ibag wurinob qamar: “An Qenut mian yab igour munon yurau end isari animbogounor.” Ende qamara qataben isub gamir eng iam wout uburerei.
Ende gab gari qas Qenut igub mismisir wot uber qamb bo igeser diab Yisas menmant end wonou git goan arir inab Yisast ‘uber’ qamb atag arei. Munon eng git Samaria munon.
Ende aba Yisas der qamar: “Ye an munon yurau gugum ende mom uberburab uburumanei quraum eng qei eret igamari ne gari dian?
Munon e Isrel munon ue ego wonou gari Qenut oabig wot ab aba. Meimet qamb Isrel munon qei musine uberetorour eng ende me obour?”
Ende qamb munon eng nob qamar: “Nonou oau apand end ne uberaran, end der naget isi,” ende nob qamarei.
17:20-37 Munangit wau dibeneriba
Ne Parisi munon qei der Yisas qebi qamamir: “Qenu wonou bibis eng qen mait deriba?” Qamarari Yisas taui qamar: “Qenu wonou bibis eng dara munon magqurt maigas me gunerei.
Munon ger der, “ge, e darar e, qo ire dara ire” ende me qomurunorei. Qenu wonou bibis ansirbig ig eng qenen qomon uber animbig ne anoar igo.”
Ende qamb wonou imbigau yurau eng wurinob qamar: “Qen geret Munangit wau wonou qen eng yara an gub qamb qenungouboumon. Ego an maigas me gunanei.
Ende abari munon qei der anmurimar ete qomorubour, “Ire dara ire gaiar, qo mere darar e gaiar,” Ende qamarari igub an apand qamb is gub qamb me asi qib igoarar.
Ai qebisi ne ai gugum umo ite begent ubura gaumon nami ende Munangit wau wonou qen eng gor ende gas ebeiba.
Ego se qamart wo git goan borusi uter wab ende aba munon qen see igour eng mogirt wab wogubour.
Wugunerei igama Munangit wau wonou qen eng yara qoan Noa wonou qen gas ende dieriba.
Noa wonou qen eng ete ebetemirei, Mi uber-uber nub a ya nub a munon yamangar qi baub ende at igamari Noa tabin erobon isa ya qoan weib di igaramorei.
Ne Lot wonou qen end gor ende. Mi nub a mi wurisab taui mi ba. A mi ubub mon mindat, ende at igurei.
Ende at igamari Lot Sodom wogub qoa mut nomon qoamin gagam-gagam ya darau gas ende der igaramb ugarei.
Eng gas ende Munangit wau wonou qen eng mi eng gar ebeteriamor gas ende dibeneriba.”

Ende qamb qamar: “Munon ger ag bugab woromt qoariget igo qen eng yara gab bo qand der mor isub mind qamb eng me bainerei. Ne gor munon ger wonou man end mi ubub igama qen eng yara gab bo qand mor me irinerei.
Lot ubeni ebeter eng gaiar.
Munon ger wonomit igub ebeiner eng mom umiba. A munon ger wonomit igub me ebeiner eng iigomot igoriba.
Itum end munon ombur gar garit inunor eng Qenu ger mot irab ger wegiba.
Ne yamangar ombur mani yab igorunor eng Qenu ger mot irab ger wegiba.
Ne munon ombur mi ubub igorunor eng ger Qenu mot irab ger wegiba.”

Ende qamb waga wonou imbigau yurau eng der qebi qamamir: “Barai mi eng gagar quran eng eret dieriba?” Ende qamarari Yisas taui mit big qamar: “Man suab gumunorei igama morogan sanou murib baub qamb qiumunimbour,” ende qamarei.
